meta.name: e2e-testing
meta.description: Use when adding, running, or debugging proctmux end-to-end integration tests, especially PTY/TUI behavior, terminal snapshots, unified/client modes, timing flakes, VT100 emulator limits, or files under tests/e2e and internal/testharness/e2e.

copy.tagline: 运行和调试终端应用的端到端测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在为终端应用编写或排查端到端测试。
copy.tagline_en: Run and debug end-to-end tests for terminal apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build terminal apps and need to add or fix their end-to-end tests.

howto.what: 这是一个关于 proctmux 端到端集成测试的技能。装了它,Claude 会按照技能里的架构和模板来编写、运行和调试测试:用 PTY 模拟终端、发送按键、等待屏幕快照,并处理 VT100 模拟器的限制和时序问题。
howto.when: 当你要添加、运行或调试 proctmux 的端到端集成测试时触发,尤其是涉及终端界面行为、屏幕快照、统一/客户端模式等场景。

say.text: 调试失败的 e2e 测试,看看快照里为什么没有 MY_MARKER。
say.note: Claude 会检查快照和日志来定位问题。

howto.what_en: This skill covers writing, running, and debugging proctmux e2e tests via a PTY harness. Claude will create tests that start the real binary, send keystrokes, and wait for terminal snapshots, accounting for VT100 emulator limits and timing flakes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add, run, or debug proctmux e2e tests, especially around PTY/TUI behavior, terminal snapshots, unified/client modes, or files under tests/e2e.

say_en.text: Write a proctmux e2e test verifying that pressing Ctrl+W shows the process list.
say_en.note: Claude will use the test template from the skill.

say_en.text: Run all e2e tests under tests/e2e with the integration tag.
say_en.note: It will execute the go test -tags=integration command.

say_en.text: Debug this failing e2e test and find why MY_MARKER is missing from the snapshot.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect the snapshot and log file.
